1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Bestial Wrath is no longer useable when you are not in control of your character.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Silencing Shot now has a 25 second coldown (from 20), silences for 2 seconds (from 3) and deals 75% weapon damage (from 50%).

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Silencing Shot is now shares a cooldown with Interrupts and also triggers the global cooldown when used.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Wild Quiver now also procs off Steady Shot.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Enrage now makes Maul hit an additional nearby target when active.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Cower no longer awards any combo points.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Surprise Attacks now also works for Druid finishing moves.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: The Nature's Grace Capstone now works as intended.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Counterspell now has a 30 second cooldown.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Improved Blizzard now adds a 20/30/40% slow effect, from 25/40/50%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Frostbolt has had its damage and scaling increased by 4%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Brain Freeze now makes your Frostbolt and Arcane Missiles deal 3/6/10% increased damage on targets affected by your Fireball DoT.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Brain Freeze now makes the affected Fireball deal 25% increased damage in PvE (from 10%), and 10% less damage in PvP (from 20%).

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Hot Streak now increases the damage of Pyroblast by 50%, up from 35%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Fiery Payback now reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 1 second, from 1.25 seconds. It no longer reduces damage taken while under 35% health.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Veiled Shadows now gives Fade a 50/100% chance to clear all movement impairing effects.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Improved Shadowform no longer gives Fade a chance to clear movement impairing effects.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Misery now grants 7/14/20% increased spell power scaling to the affected spells, up from 5/10/15%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description:
Grounding Totem now has a 20 second cooldown, from 15.
â

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Improved Stormstrike now grants 15% base mana, from 20%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Guarded by the Light now reduces periodic spell damage taken.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Avenger's Shield now does 15% more threat.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Berserker Rage is no longer on the global cooldown.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Furious Attacks now reduces healing effects by 20/40%, from 25/50%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Bloodthirst and Mortal Strike no longer share a cooldown.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: The Improved Slam Capstone now makes Slam a guaranteed crit when used on an Incapacitated or Immobilized target.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Improved Kick has been reworked. It now gives your successful interrupts with kick a 50/100% chance to grant you 50 energy and increase your movement speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Crippling Poison now slows the targets movement speed for 40%, from 50%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Frostbrand Weapon now slows the targets movement speed for 40%, from 50%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Wind Shear now has a 18 second cooldown (from 12). Successfully interrupting an enemy only triggers a 12 second cooldown.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Shield Bash interrupts now prevent spell casts from any school for 5 seconds.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Pummel interrupts now prevent spell casts from any school for 4 seconds.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Kick interrupts now prevent spell casts from any school for 4 seconds.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description:
The increased block value from Critical Block no longer works against players.
â

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Deflection (Rogue) no longer reduces spell damage taken while Ghostly Strike is active.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Iron Will now requires a single Two-Handed weapon to work.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Booming Voice now also increases the effectiveness of Demoralizing Shout by 20/40%.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: New Talent: Improved Victory Rush - Increases the critical strike chance of your Victory Rush by 20/40/60% and gives you a 33/66/100% when you parry to allow the use of Victory Rush for 10 seconds. This effect may only occur once every 20 seconds. Victory Rush used this way generates an additional 60% threat. This talent replaced Improved Demoralizing Shout in the Fury tree.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: The Victory Rush effects of Deflection (Warrior) have been moved to the new talent Improved Victory Rush.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: New Capstone: Deflection (Warrior) - You gain damage reduction against direct damage spells equal to 33% of your Parry chance while wielding a Two-Handed weapon. Does not work against players.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: New Capstone: Intensify Rage - Your successful interrupts with Pummel now Immobilizes the target for 3 seconds and grants you Bloodrage (at no health cost).

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: New Capstone: Burning Determination - Being hit by an Interrupt effect when you are not casting makes you immune to the next Silence or Interrupt effect. This may only occur once every 20 seconds.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: Burning Determination is now a three point talent that reduces your damage taken by 5/10/15% while Silenced.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: New Capstone: Spiritual Focus - Being hit by an interrupt effect when you are not casting makes your next Holy Shock a guaranteed critical strike. This may only occur once every 20 seconds.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: New Capstone: Celestial Focus - Being hit by an Interrupt effect when you are not casting makes your next Entangling Roots cast within 10 seconds an instant cast. This may only occur once every 20 seconds.

1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: New Capstone: Frozen Core - Being hit by an Interrupt effect when you are not casting reduces the cast time of your spells by 10% for 10 seconds. This may only occur once every 20 seconds.
